en: The image is a sepia-toned photograph depicting a large industrial complex with several multistory factory buildings and tall smokestacks, surrounded by trees and other buildings. The setting is typical of an early 20th-century European industrial town. The postcard has German text printed at the top: 'Lunzenau a. Mulde.' on the left and 'Vogel's Mechan. Weberei und Papierfabrik.' on the right.
